project.title: Experience & advantages - David Whyte
project.format: immersive companion-portal introduction with canvas, audio loops, and map-driven wayfinding

why: A distinctive reference for bringing editorial, audio, and membership-product storytelling into one immersive entry flow: the page uses watercolor-style stage media, sound controls, a scroll-to-explore prompt, and map-backed navigation to make a content archive feel like an explorable world.

compositions.title: Dedicated experience loader
compositions.study: The page has a specific LoaderExperience component before the exploratory stage begins, which separates the portal from the surrounding marketing site.
compositions.reuse: Use a dedicated loader when a special-mode experience should feel distinct from the rest of the site.

compositions.title: Canvas-led portal shell
compositions.study: A shared canvas, hidden video textures, audio loops, and stage controls frame the portal as one continuous environment rather than a collection of article cards.
compositions.reuse: Treat media, sound, and navigation as one shell when the goal is to create a world instead of a page.

compositions.title: Exploration steps into portal features
compositions.study: The experience introduces archive, map, poetry, and membership benefits as staged reveals with their own copy and CTA layers.
compositions.reuse: Use progressive feature reveals when a content-heavy platform would feel too abstract as a static benefits list.

assets.notes: The page preloads base and over video textures for the experience stage rather than relying on one visible hero clip.
assets.reuse: Layer quiet texture channels behind a canvas stage when the atmosphere matters as much as the content.

assets.role: loader, scroll cue, and sound controls
assets.notes: Loader, scroll prompt, and sound state are surfaced as explicit stage overlays, not hidden implementation details.
assets.reuse: Make media controls visible when sound and pacing are core to the story.

assets.role: portal feature reveals across archive, maps, and membership
assets.notes: The experience combines portal copy, CTAs, audio, and supporting visuals to present multiple content surfaces inside one guided journey.
assets.reuse: Bundle feature explanation with sensory cues when a platform's value is experiential rather than purely functional.

motion.title: Portal boot before exploration
motion.notes: The experience isolates its own loader and then hands off into a dedicated scroll-to-explore stage.
motion.fallback: Keep the portal discoverable through a plain content path if the animated stage cannot boot.

motion.title: Guided exploration through portal benefits
motion.notes: A Scroll to explore control introduces a staged journey through library, map, and membership features instead of a static landing page.
motion.fallback: Exploration prompts should degrade to visible section links or buttons when animation is reduced.

motion.title: Ambient media plus looped soundscape
motion.notes: The experience coordinates hidden video textures with several looped audio tracks to create atmosphere around the portal.
motion.fallback: Sound must remain opt-in and the story should still read without autoplay media.

interactions.title: Persistent sound state control
interactions.study: The stage exposes an explicit sound switch instead of assuming visitors want audio by default.
interactions.reuse: Use a persistent sound affordance whenever audio materially shapes the experience.

interactions.title: Map-backed literary navigation
interactions.study: Mapbox dependencies and copy about exploring literary landscapes position map navigation as a content surface, not a side utility.
interactions.reuse: Use when place is part of the story and the map should behave like narrative navigation rather than a locator widget.

interactions.title: Canvas-first exploration shell
interactions.study: The experience relies on a dedicated canvas, hidden media textures, and stage-layer controls to organize the interaction model.
interactions.reuse: Keep the interaction shell explicit when the page behaves more like an environment than a document.

implementation.format: WordPress experience page with custom loader, canvas stage, audio loops, and map-backed portal navigation
implementation.notes: Static inspection confirmed a dedicated loader, experience canvas, hidden video textures, multiple audio loops, Scroll to explore control, sound toggle, and mapbox-backed portal navigation.
